description: Advance the unitree-g1 planar biped forward by a goal distance using a deterministic IK stepping gait. Success when torso reaches goal within step budget; otherwise a physics timeout.
Walk forward and step over a low curb (0.04 m half-height) to reach a target X coordinate using the same gait. Reports obstacleContact=true when the swing foot clears the curb.
Hold the current pose; no forward motion. Always succeeds when paid and proves the bounded/interruptible policy.
